summary: Hartford's insurance units filed an 8-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 Reinsurance Commutation and Release Agreement with National Indemnity (Berkshire Hathaway), terminating the aggregate excess-of-loss reinsurance covering asbestos/environmental adverse development since December 31, 2016, and resolving confidential arbitration. On September 25, 2026, Hartford received $1.12 billion cash and the treaty was commuted. Hartford expects a $497 million pretax gain, $393 million net income increase, and no core-earnings impact for Q3/9M 2026 from deferred-gain release. Watch reserve adequacy post-commutation and any arbitration-related disclosures.
